name: Compulink Cable Assemblies Inc.
old_description: COMPULINK SPECIALIZES IN WIRE HARNESS ASSEMBLY AND CUSTOM MOLDED CABLE ASSEMBLIES
about:
Compulink Cable Assemblies Inc. was founded in 1984 in St. Petersburg, Florida. The company has operated from its Florida base for four decades, building a focus on wire harness and custom molded cable assembly manufacturing.

The company produces wire harness assemblies, custom molded cable assemblies, coaxial cable assemblies, electro-mechanical assemblies, box builds, and control panel fabrications. Its capabilities include low-pressure molding, rapid prototyping, quick-turn services, engineering support, first-article production, and value-added component sourcing. Compulink serves prototype through volume production runs, integrating components such as printed circuit boards, fans, switches, and power supplies into finished assemblies.

Compulink serves original equipment manufacturers and military contractors across defense, renewable energy (solar and wind), industrial, medical, commercial, and transportation sectors. The firm is ITAR and EAR registered, supplying military harnesses and molded assemblies used in defense equipment worldwide, as well as RF and coaxial assemblies for wireless applications.

Compulink differentiates itself through an AS9100D:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, with all personnel trained to IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship standards and in-house Level A instructors. A dedicated crimp quality assurance lab uses a Schleuniger MicroGraph System for cross-sectional crimp analysis. The company emphasizes lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, on-time delivery metrics, and invites customer audits of its facilities and quality system.
